config.missing_public_payload_behavior: explicit fallback weights; no hidden future or simulator state fields are read
config.normalization_rule: group eligible actions by public category; apply public-state category multipliers; normalize positive category weights; then sample within the chosen category by public action score

rule_groups.card_rewards: prefer early damage, draw, energy, and scaling; prefer defense when visible HP is low; keep skips and weak cards reachable
rule_groups.events: conservative label-based priors avoid visible damage/curse costs when low HP while keeping legal branches reachable
rule_groups.fallback: unknown or missing public payloads use positive fallback weights rather than deterministic first-action behavior
rule_groups.resources: take relics/treasure by default; keep skips, potion discards, and keys as low-probability legal alternatives
rule_groups.rest_sites: prefer upgrades by default, but boost rest when current HP is low
rule_groups.route_choices: use action labels and public resources as route proxies; prefer elites with healthy HP or potions, prefer rests/shops when low
rule_groups.shops: prefer removals, high-impact relic/cards, useful potions with empty slots, and retain some gold by keeping skip reachable
